subject: [PATCH 1/2] sched/numa: do not let the per-VMA PID filter gate promotion

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Addressed a reported issue where slow_only=false was set unconditionally, causing premature re-admission of VMAs. Proposed changes to patch 1 and 2 were outlined, with plans for a v2 next week after testing.

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a performance issue in the Linux kernel's NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) balancing mechanism, specifically related to VMA (Virtual Memory Area) scanning and promotion. The current implementation allows per-VMA PID filtering to gate promotion, leading to inefficient scanning and potential performance bottlenecks. The proposed changes modify the vma_is_accessed() function to allow scanning of rejected VMAs, promoting candidates from the whole address space while maintaining top-tier marking unchanged.
